case_26.reason: The bisection maintains the invariant count(x>=lo)>=k and converges (40 halvings in fp32 typically reach the exact k-th value), so the output keeps all entries >= the k-th largest and zeroes the rest — the 'admit all ties' reading, which the spec explicitly accepts; the kept-set is always a threshold set, so 'every kept entry >= every dropped entry' holds. Only pathological inputs (-inf entries, enormous dynamic range, k=0) would degrade it, which the stated contract doesn't cover.
